sourceChecks.instruction: Open the official Istanbul touristic-camera page, choose SULTANAHMET, and confirm the live stream plays.

sourceChecks.instruction: Open the direct KG Camera Karakol Ski Base page and confirm the lower-lift image/video updates normally.

sourceChecks.title: Shymbulak — Trans-Ili Alatau
sourceChecks.instruction: Open the official Shymbulak live page and confirm at least one mountain camera visibly updates.

sourceChecks.title: Bled — Lake & Castle Views

sourceChecks.title: Dubrovnik — Pile
sourceChecks.instruction: Open the exact official city camera page and confirm the video moves/updates normally.

sourceChecks.title: Everest & Khumbu — Hotel Everest View
sourceChecks.instruction: Open the Hotel Everest View live page and confirm the image/video is current before ERN promotes it.

sourceChecks.title: Grand Baie — Mauritius
sourceChecks.instruction: Open the official Mauritius Now page, enter the webcam experience, and confirm the Grand Baie camera is present and visibly current.

sourceChecks.title: Khumbu Glacier — Everest Region
sourceChecks.instruction: Open the Khumbu Glacier camera and confirm the current image refreshes or has a reliable current timestamp.

sourceChecks.title: Malta — Official Live Cams
sourceChecks.instruction: Open the official Live Malta Cams page and confirm at least one destination camera visibly updates before ERN promotes any specific Malta place.

sourceChecks.title: Mykonos — New Port Live
sourceChecks.instruction: Open the municipal Mykonos live-stream page and confirm at least one New Port camera moves normally.

sourceChecks.title: Panama Canal — Agua Clara Locks
sourceChecks.instruction: Choose Agua Clara Locks on the official Panama Canal camera service and confirm real-time ship/lock activity.

sourceChecks.title: Panama Canal — Gatún Locks
sourceChecks.instruction: Open the official Panama Canal web-camera area, choose Gatún Locks, and confirm the view updates in real time.

sourceChecks.title: Panama Canal — Miraflores Locks
sourceChecks.instruction: Open the Panama Canal Authority Web Cameras section, choose Miraflores Locks, and confirm ships/locks are updating in real time.
